pois.name: Kawasan Dago Pakar
pois.description: Bandung's elevated forest-edge zone at the foot of Tangkuban Perahu volcano — where the city grid gives way to pine forests, hillside cafés, and panoramic Bandung Basin views. The coolest part of an already-cool city.

pois.name: Babakan Siliwangi
pois.description: Bandung's beloved urban forest park along the Cikapundung River — 'Baksil' to locals. Trails through bamboo groves and tropical secondary forest, with the river running below steep terraced banks.

pois.name: Dago Café District
pois.description: Jalan Ir. H. Juanda (Dago) and its side streets host Bandung's most concentrated strip of independent cafés — a mix of renovated Dutch villas and industrial-chic warehouses serving exceptional Indonesian coffee.

pois.name: Institut Teknologi Bandung
pois.description: Indonesia's most prestigious technical university (1920), with a striking blend of Art Deco and Sundanese architecture. The main Aula Barat and Aula Timur auditoriums were designed by Henri Maclaine Pont.
